Forecast.DayComments: Rain likely, possibly mixed with snow showers. Some thunder is also possible.  Cloudy, with a steady temperature around 39. South southwest wind around 8 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 60%. Little or no snow accumulation expected.
Forecast.NightComments: Rain likely, possibly mixed with snow, mainly before midnight.  Mostly cloudy, with a low around 37. South wind 5 to 8 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 70%. Little or no snow accumulation expected.

Resorts.ParkingAreasDescription: Solitude Bike Park opens May, 22. Parking will be free in the Moonbeam and Village Parking Lots for the 2026 summer season. Ride Link chairlift for free to travel between Solitude Village and Moonbeam base area.
